title: Permanent Bug Repair Definition of Done and Owner Convergence Gate
scope: Documentation-only permanent engineering governance. No production runtime, gameplay, UI, assets, workflows, save, cloud data, version or main changes.

requirements.request: Every bug repair must distinguish DIAGNOSED, IMPLEMENTED, INTEGRATED, DEPLOYED and VERIFIED; only VERIFIED may be reported as fixed.
Every production bug repair must pass an Owner Convergence Gate covering responsibility inventory, multi-owner scan, canonical owner, patch retirement, lifecycle closure and final-state verification.
The project owner decides product outcomes; agents must proactively reject unsafe implementation patterns and own technical migration/retirement decisions.
All agent entry documents and repair contracts must require this permanent gate for bug/failure work.
